gen-gf-autour-one-fs-gambetta: Autour One draws bold, rounded letters with strokes that never swell or thin, while Gambetta, a text serif, shifts weight gently. Related enough to sit together, different enough to keep the page moving.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-abyssinica-sil: Abyssinica SIL reads literary, with a tall middle zone in every word. Autour One heads it with bold, rounded letters whose strokes never vary, against the body's mellow, brushed-watercolor shift in weight.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-cambo: Cambo, a refined serif, keeps a short step from lowercase to capital and a mid-range gap between its boldest and faintest strokes. Autour One shouts in fat crossbars; Cambo does the quiet reading.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-fanwood-text: Fanwood Text has a large-eyed lowercase and gentle swelling on curves, with only moderate contrast between its strokes. The strongest pull is Autour One, drawn like a ballpoint line.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-holtwood-one-sc: Autour One keeps open, rod-stock strokes of identical thickness, while Holtwood One SC closes its curves to a sliver. Towering and wide-tracked, Holtwood One SC needs only a modest size.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-manuale: Manuale reads traditional and editorial, with a large-eyed lowercase and contrast that stays moderate. And Autour One, with rounded-nib strokes and no swelling at the ends, earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-naskh-arabic: Blunt headline, gentle serif text. Autour One holds a single constant stroke weight, while Noto Naskh Arabic adds modest modulation, like lightly engraved brass, beneath a very tall x-height.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-nastaliq-urdu: Blunt and unshaded: Autour One never swells along its outlines. Noto Nastaliq Urdu feels editorial and dignified beside it, with mellow contrast, tight vertical rhythm, and little ascender sticking up.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-rashi-hebrew: Noto Rashi Hebrew has short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies, with modest contrast like lightly engraved brass. But Autour One traces every stroke at a single stylus width, so paragraphs below it read with bookish ease.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-noto-serif-ahom: Noto Serif Ahom reads traditional and dignified, with a lofty lowercase body and joins that taper modestly without vanishing. Autour One, stout in every diagonal, gives it a sturdy, weighty companion.
